benchmark.workflow: scripts/profile_compare.py alternating paired serial route benchmarks
benchmark.note: GPU render improved consistently by roughly 0.065 ms in this single fire/profile and M1 Max/Metal route. Whole-frame paired deltas are mixed and small (median -0.012 ms); this does not establish broad usefulness or portability.

sustained_orbit.camera_route: 20-second orbit with a close-smoke approach at the loop seam (120 px projected height), repeated six times; the path then crosses both LOD thresholds and both return thresholds.
